payment.cbAlert: Once you submit your payment, it can't be modified or cancelled.

billingOptions.clickToCancelText:
Enrolling in EasyPay for automatic monthly payments is required for Mobile Services. You can update your payment method anytime through Cox App or MyAccount.

To cancel Cox Services, provide 24 hours' notice via Cox App or MyAccount. Agent-assisted cancellations (chat, phone, or retail) are also available.
billingOptions.easyPayModalBody:
By electronically signing below, you expressly agree to be enrolled by Cox in EasyPay recurring payments. Your signature acknowledges that you are an authorized signer with the financial institution for the bank account, credit card, or debit card indicated above and you understand this account will be charged/debited the total amount due automatically each month on the date provided within your bill, or other electronic notification you select, such as email or SMS. You expressly agree to authorize Cox to utilize consumer reporting information, and other fraud detection services to determine if we will accept your payment.  You agree that if this payment is returned or rejected by your financial institution for any reason, Cox may reattempt this payment until it can be successfully drafted from your financial institution or until at Cox’s sole discretion the payment is deemed unable to be processed.  If Cox deems the payment is unable to be processed, you understand and agree that we may charge your Cox account a returned payment fee up to the maximum allowed by law. You acknowledge and understand that EasyPay payments may continue to be processed, even after your Cox account is closed, as long as a balance is due to Cox.  You further understand that Cox may cancel your enrollment at any time, and you may revoke your consent by contacting Cox, however if you revoke your consent you may no longer be eligible for specific promotions, offers, products or services.

Cox is required to provide you a written copy of your EasyPay authorization. By electronically signing below and accepting the EasyPay Terms of Service, you acknowledge receipt of your EasyPay Authorization Agreement.
